limitations: The tests are scoped, not the formal full suite. Earlier working-tree test evidence is reused only for unchanged semantics; final edits were formatting/borrow cleanup, ParseResult Debug preservation, negative controls, documentation and tooling. The final raw-view test and syntax receipt tests were rerun at the exact commit.
The oracle candidate snapshot differs from committed source only by rustfmt formatting, checked independently before commit; committed preflight SHA256 matches the source checked then.
Raw capacity bounds retained raw item count, not bytes or dependency-receipt count; current large graphs and a bounded set of old raw roots may retain corresponding metadata.
No compile-time speedup, Rust comparability, memory-byte ceiling, function-granular incrementality or product gate is certified by this review.
The oracle is synthetic machine IR and does not establish source reachability or native performance for the exponential DAG pattern.
